## What you’ll see

In Lima, you’ll see several chapters of Peru’s history through pre-Inca sites, Spanish architecture, the city’s main square and museum collections of ancient cultures. In Cusco, the itinerary focuses on Inca heritage, with visits to Sacsayhuamán, Qorikancha, Tambomachay and Puka Pukara.

The main day of the trip is devoted to Machu Picchu. The route then continues through the Sacred Valley, taking in Pisac, Ollantaytambo, Chinchero, Moray and the Awanakancha centre, where you can see llamas, alpacas and vicuñas.
